name: Improved Symbiant Adaptation
body:
Prerequisites: Symbiant Adaptation, symbiant race, fire and sonic vulnerability racial trait.

Benefit: Choose fire or sonic. You are no longer vulnerable to damage of the chosen type, nor do you take any penalties to your saving throws against non-damaging effects of that type (if you chose fire, this applies to light effects as well).
